d.d: third-person singular simple present indicative of cypher

An evergreen coniferous tree with flattened shoots bearing small scale-like leaves, whose dark foliage is sometimes associated with mourning, in family Cupressaceae, especially the genera Cupressus and Chamaecyparis.
Alternative form of Cyprus (“type of fabric”).
Of, from, or relating to Cyprus.
A thin, translucent, usually black fabric, a kind of crape.
An island and country in the Mediterranean Sea, normally considered politically part of Europe but geographically part of West Asia. Official name: Republic of Cyprus. Capital: Nicosia.
